restoration_note: The teaching describes the Five Garments / Five Mysteries by which First Man clothes himself: the rational in five degrees, going forth as Call and met by Answer (5×5=20 characters in 20 members), purified through the 50-day type that opens out into 100 holy days as the soul is fed by Jesus the Radiance. Restorations were strongly constrained at the editor's noted spots (line-break completions for ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲡⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ/ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ, ⲧⲣⲟⲫⲏ, ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲏⲕⲟⲥⲧⲏ, ⲡⲟⲩⲓⲱⲧ, ⲛⲁⲧⲡⲉ, ⲛⲍⲏⲧⲟⲩ, ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ) and at structural anchors where the Call/Answer/food triad recurs (Five Sons, mysteries-of-Call-and-Answer recap). The catastrophically damaged middle (sections 5158, 5161-5163, parts of 5165) was left unrestorable: 8 gaps without sufficient grammatical or formulaic constraint. The remaining 45 gaps were filled, of which roughly half are editor-confirmed letter-completions and half are conjectural fills anchored in the lexicon's vocabulary for Call/Answer (Great Counsel), Five Sons, garments, and the descent of Jesus the Radiance as living food.
